sentence: 我昨天看了一部非常漂亮的电影。
note: particle, numeral and punctuation dropped; pronoun, time word, adverb, adjective and noun kept

sentence: 他在图书馆学习。
note: 在 is HSK1 vocabulary, not the Japanese-particle analogue: p is mined

sentence: 这个电影非常有意思。
note: demonstrative r and set phrase l are both core vocabulary

sentence: 今天我在家里学习中文。
note: time word t, place word s, preposition p and the nz catch-all all mine

sentence: 他把书放在桌子的里面。
note: locative noun f and the 把 marker mine; the 的 particle does not

sentence: 今天太阳很大，这个城市的东西我不明白。
note: jieba's dictionary tags all four ns or nr, and all four are ordinary vocabulary

sentence: 这些东西都是新鲜的。
note: 新鲜 is another dictionary ns

sentence: 受台风影响，明天不上课。
note: 台风 is ns in jieba's dictionary — a weather word, not a place

sentence: 然后我们一起去喝咖啡吧。
note: jieba cuts 喝咖啡 as one nr token, so neither 喝 nor 咖啡 exists to mine separately; 一起 stays out as m

sentence: 这是最主要的原因。
note: 区别词 b — jieba files 主要 in a class of its own

sentence: 所有的学生都来了。
note: another b word a beginner meets in the first week

sentence: 整个房间一片黑暗。
note: b and z in one line; 一片 stays out as m

sentence: 他高兴地跳了起来。
note: 高兴 is HSK1 and jieba tags it b; the 地 adverbial particle stays out

sentence: 她穿着雪白的裙子。
note: 状态词 z — prose adjectives jieba keeps out of a

sentence: 他悄悄地走了进来。
note: jieba tags the whole 悄悄地 z; whether a 地 form earns a card is the definition stage's call

sentence: 因为下雨，所以我没去。
note: conjunctions are HSK1-3 vocabulary in Chinese

sentence: 虽然很累，但是我很开心。
note: the 虽然…但是 pair is a grammar point a learner drills

sentence: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去公园。
note: 如果 is c; the rest of the line is ordinary t/n/d vocabulary

sentence: 我跟朋友从学校走回来。
note: 介词 p — 跟 and 从 carry meaning a learner has to know

sentence: 为了考试，除了睡觉他都在看书。
note: multi-character prepositions mine like the single-character ones

sentence: 关于这个问题，我对你的看法比他好。
note: three more p words in one line

sentence: 我买了三本书和两个杯子。
note: conjunction 和 mines; bare numerals m stay out

sentence: 这间房子大概有八十平方米。
note: numeral m and classifier q both stay out

sentence: 他一口气喝了两瓶啤酒。
note: 成语 i mines; 喝 is a bound vg fragment here and stays excluded

sentence: 你别生气了，我给你道个歉。
note: preposition 给 mines; the q classifiers and the ng fragment beside it do not

sentence: 这部手机支持5G网络和无线充电。
note: Latin runs are eng and digits m; the conjunction between them mines

sentence: 她说：“真的吗？”
note: full-width colon and curly quotes are x

sentence: 「你先别激动，」他说。
note: corner brackets are x as well

sentence: 爱因斯坦是一位科学家。
note: nrt stays excluded: a transliterated personal name is a name in every context

sentence: 王小明明天要去上海出差。
note: nr and ns clear the POS gate; a name no dictionary lists is dropped a stage later, not here

sentence: 国家统计局今天发布了第三季度经济数据。
note: nt organisations stay excluded

sentence: 他做事一向小心翼翼。
note: a four-character chengyu arrives as one i token

sentence: 这事儿我明天再跟你说。
note: the erhua surface is mined as written; 跟 beside it is p

sentence: 台灣的夜市很有名。
note: traditional text: jieba cuts a simplified copy and the original slices come back out

sentence: 他在台北車站附近租了套房。
note: Taiwan vocabulary in traditional script

sentence: 妳今天怎麼看起來這麼累？
note: 妳 is the Taiwan feminine 'you'; jieba tags it zg

sentence: 我們週末要不要去陽明山走走？
note: a traditional place name jieba reads as nr
